targets.query:
from(bucket: "energy")
    |> range(
        start: v.timeRangeStart,
        stop: v.timeRangeStop
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        r._measurement == "energy_balance"
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        r.device == "energy_balance_validator"
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        r._field == "pv_power_kw" or
        r._field == "load_power_kw" or
        r._field == "bess_power_kw" or
        r._field == "grid_power_kw"
    )
    |> aggregateWindow(
        every: v.windowPeriod,
        fn: mean,
        createEmpty: true
    )
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        r with
        _field:
            if r._field == "pv_power_kw" then "PV Generation"
            else if r._field == "load_power_kw" then "Household Load"
            else if r._field == "bess_power_kw" then "BESS Power"
            else "Grid Power"
    }))
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> yield(name: "system_power")

panels.description: Comparison of EMS requested battery power and actual BESS power after applying battery protection limits.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "energy")
    |> range(
        start: v.timeRangeStart,
        stop: v.timeRangeStop
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        (
            r._measurement == "ems" and
            r._field == "requested_bess_power_kw" and
            r.device == "ems_controller"
        ) or
        (
            r._measurement == "bess" and
            r._field == "power_kw" and
            r.device == "alphaess_simulator"
        )
    )
    |> aggregateWindow(
        every: v.windowPeriod,
        fn: mean,
        createEmpty: true
    )
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        r with
        _field:
            if r._measurement == "ems"
            then "Requested BESS Power"
            else "Actual BESS Power"
    }))
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> yield(name: "bess_power_comparison")
